thread:
Sam R: Deploy finished for optimize-v2 -> prod-usw2. deploy-bot reports nodes patched. Kicking off post-deploy verification with 1% mirrored traffic to canary. pinging @Tia N and @Leo (oncall).

deploy-bot: POST-DEPLOY VERIFY: canary=1% | checks=[health,latency,error_rate,synthetic] | summary: health=OK, error_rate=0.12%, p95=82ms, synthetic/hello-gen=PASS

Tia N: Noting a small cluster of 502s on the rerank route over last 2m (~3 failures / ~260 mirrored reqs). Low signal but curious. Starting targeted log pull and running rerank-heavy synthetic.

Leo (oncall): pulled logs — looks like those failures are upstream timeouts from inference-worker-004 at 14:03:22Z. snippet: 

```
[2026-03-21T14:03:22Z] inference-worker-004 ERROR upstream timeout id=abc123 route=rerank latency=5120ms
[2026-03-21T14:03:22Z] routing-proxy WARN request-id=abc123 status=502
```

Leo (oncall): lowered canary mirror to 0.5% and enabled soft-fallback for rerank-route -> model v1-quant so any failures fall back to safe model. Also increased proxy retry_budget to 3 while we investigate.

Sam R: Good mitigation. Can we enable failed-trace sampling (x-request-id) and attach traces to the release ticket? Also add an alert: error_rate > 1% over 3m OR p95 > 250ms -> page oncall.

Nick P: I vote holding rollout at 0.5% for 30m. If error_rate > 1% or sustained p95 > 250ms for two consecutive 5m windows we roll back to v1. I'll create rollback ticket RL-6891 and pre-populate runbook steps.

Amara (PM): I'll draft a brief customer-facing note in the release doc about a short performance tuning window and that we're monitoring; will post to release-notes channel in ~10m. Flagging customers only if we need to escalate.

Tia N: With soft-fallback active, production traffic remains largely unaffected. I'm running an extra synthetic suite focused on rerank (100 prompts, every 5m) to bump signal. Will post results here.

Sam R: Agreed plan: hold at 0.5% mirror, gather failed traces, run rerank synthetics every 5m, alerting per Nick. If thresholds breached -> immediate rollback per RL-6891. If stable for 30m we'll ramp to 5% then follow usual cadence to 25%.

deploy-bot: MONITORING: alert created deploy/optimize-v2/prod-usw2/error_rate>1% (3m) -> page=oncall | dashboard=https://internal.metrics/services/optimize-v2?from=now-1h | rollback_ticket=RL-6891

Tia N: :thumbsup: first synthetic rerank sweep completed: 100q -> 0 failures, mean latency +6ms vs baseline. I'll keep running every 5m. If I see repeat 502s I'll call the rollback.

Leo (oncall): added 2 temporary replicas to inference-worker pool to smooth tail latency during triage. Removing after we clear the hold.

Sam R: Thanks all. I'll update the release notes with the holdpoint, link to RL-6891 runbook, and keep this thread open for the 30m hold window. Closing decision posted after monitoring window.
